Hello Diego — a note about this week's meeting.

Let's meet **Wednesday at 10:00am**, 30 minutes, in my office. The department tells me your CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week, so the slot is free even if your calendar still shows the class.

Could you confirm, and put it on your calendar? If 10:00 doesn't work after all, tell me what does and I'll move it.

Hello — checking one thing before I confirm my week: Professor Alvarez tells me my CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00-11:00 is cancelled this week. Can you confirm whether CSE451 is cancelled on Wednesday, and whether there are any other changes to the CSE444/CSE451/CSE452/CSE455 schedule this week? Thank you.

Hello. CSE451 is **not** cancelled: it meets Wednesday 10:00-11:00 as scheduled. There are no changes this week for CSE444, CSE451, CSE452 or CSE455 — the full schedule stands:

- Mon 09:00-10:00 TA section
- Mon 10:00-11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30-11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00-11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE452 lecture
- Thu 11:00-12:00 CSE455 office hours
- Thu 14:00-15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30-12:00 CSE444 lecture

I can't speak to individual instructors' plans, so if you were told otherwise please check with Professor Alvarez directly.
Hi Professor — thanks, Wednesday 10:00 works for me. I'm just confirming the CSE451 cancellation with the department office and will get back to you with a definite yes in a moment.

Hi Professor — I checked with the department office, and CSE451 is **not** cancelled: it meets Wednesday 10:00-11:00 as scheduled, and they say the full week's schedule stands. So unfortunately 10:00-10:30 doesn't work for me — I'm in class then.

Could we do one of these instead (all 30 min, in your office)?

- **Wednesday 12:30-13:00** (first free slot after my grading block)
- **Wednesday 15:00-15:30**
- **Tuesday 11:30-12:00**
- **Monday 11:30-12:00**

Tell me which one you prefer and I'll put it on my calendar and confirm right away.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. One question about this week's schedule, please.

I was told this morning that Diego's CSE451 lecture on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 is cancelled this week. Diego has just checked with your office and was told the opposite: that it meets as scheduled and the whole week stands.

Could you confirm which is right — is CSE451 meeting on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 this week, and is there any change to the week's lectures, seminars or university meetings at all? I'd like it from you directly before I book anything.

Hello Professor Alvarez. From this office's official schedule: **CSE451 meets on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as normal**, and there is no change to the week at all — no lectures, seminars or scheduled university meetings have been cancelled or moved:

- Mon 09:00-10:00 TA section
- Mon 10:00-11:30 CSE444 lecture
- Tue 09:30-11:00 CSE452 lecture
- Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE444 lecture
- Wed 10:00-11:00 CSE451 lecture
- Thu 09:00-10:30 CSE452 lecture
- Thu 11:00-12:00 CSE455 office hours
- Thu 14:00-15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30-12:00 CSE444 lecture

I have no record of a cancellation for Wednesday, so anything you heard to that effect did not come through this office.

Thanks for checking — you're right, and the office confirmed it to me directly too: CSE451 meets Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as normal, and nothing in the week has changed. So let's drop 10:00.

Let's take your first option: **Wednesday 12:30–13:00, my office**. Please put it on your calendar — I've noted it on mine. If anything shifts, tell me and we'll move it.
Thank you — that's what I needed. I'll treat CSE451 as meeting Wednesday 10:00–11:00 and the week as unchanged. The cancellation I heard this morning did not come from you, so I won't act on it.

Done — **Wednesday 12:30–13:00, your office** is on my calendar. (I've left the regular 14:00-15:00 1:1 where it was; say the word if you'd rather we fold this into that one and drop the 12:30.) If anything shifts I'll let you know.

Confirmed then: **Wednesday 12:30–13:00, my office** — it's on my calendar too.

Let's keep the 14:00–15:00 1:1 as it is, separate from this one. See you Wednesday.
Great — both on my calendar as separate meetings. See you Wednesday at 12:30.
